_comment: Copy to loris_client_config.json and chmod 600. Required: api (base_url, username, password), verify_ssl, notification_defaults, collections. Every other key is optional and shown with its default; delete any you do not change. Project paths come only from collections: each project is <base_path>/<name>.
_comment_loris_profile: LORIS-MRI profile name sent to the BIDS import endpoint. The file lives on the LORIS-MRI host in dicom-archive/.loris_mri/, not on this host.
_comment_imaging: DICOM only. header_reader: dcmdump (default, no LORIS-MRI needed), get_dicom_info (also set get_dicom_info_path or mri_code_path), or pydicom (also set python_bin and header_dump_script).
